title: Who You Give It To
label: ch:mr-object-marking
canDo: I can mark a person I act on with -lā and leave a thing bare, and I can say that I give or bring something to somebody.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R47-give-it-to and say three sentences whose -lā does three different jobs: the experiencer who likes, the person seen, and the person given to.
payoff.note: The dative marker has been in the book since chapter 16 and only ever on an experiencer; this chapter names its other two jobs.
